youtube_description:
₹101, ₹501, ₹1,100... why the extra ₹1, every single time?

In tradition: a zero means an end, so ₹1 more makes it a fresh start. ₹501 can't be split equally, so the blessing stays whole. The coin is metal (dhatu), seen as a form of Goddess Lakshmi. The ₹1 is a seed, meant to be saved so it grows. And it means continuity: the relationship and the giving go on.

Money rule: don't spend the whole envelope; keep a part aside and let it grow.
Moral: Every big amount starts with ₹1 saved.

Sources: IANS via The Tribune (2024); The Quint.
